claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if circulator-based bidirectionality is displaced (e.g., duplex-fiber OCS architectures win) or the product line is discontinued; upgrade when any OCS deployment names its circulator supplier or volumes are disclosed.
claims.statement: Coherent officially productizes optical circulator technology it describes as vertically integrated, packaged as a bi-di circulator adaptor enabling bidirectional transmission over a single fiber — the first named supplier on the graph's optical-circulator chokepoint (the component Google's Apollo re-engineered for O-band datacenter-scale bidirectional OCS links). Limits: vendor self-report; adaptor is a transceiver-port product and the mapping to link-level OCS circulator volumes is unverified; Google's actual circulator sourcing undisclosed; Molex and others also market circulators but lack ingested verbatim here.

source_doc.permission_basis: Public press release; URL and short excerpts.
source_doc.title: Coherent OFC 2024 portfolio press release (bi-di circulator adaptor)

sources.quote: Bi-di circulator adaptor based on Coherent's vertically integrated circulator technology that enables bi-directional transmission over a single fiber between two transceivers in a compact footprint compatible with all transceiver LC connector ports.
